buildCommand: if [ -z "$API_BASE_URL" ]; then echo 'Set API_BASE_URL in the Vercel project environment.' >&2; exit 1; fi && if cd flutter; then git pull && cd ..; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL="$API_BASE_URL"
